summary: Fixed the existing candidate runtime so failed or rejected observations preserve prior incremental hashes and only validated results update the cache. Accepted PARTIAL news observations retain unseen stable IDs while complete observations, including COMPLETE_ZERO, replace the cache; successful S-031 snapshots retain only current incident IDs. Added five offline regression tests and documented the Issue #14 acceptance mapping without promoting candidates.
not_done: Issue #14 remains open: seven actual valid observation days per source, live anonymous source readback, independent source coverage, rights approval, and runtime/UI acceptance were not performed or fabricated. No live collection, production data/policy change, deployment, push, PR, or issue closure. Detail-cap backlog behavior was not changed. Full project tests are not green on this Windows baseline: the Python run reported 1541 tests with 17 failures, 86 errors and 12 skips; Web reported 795/800 passes. Blockers include admitted-base O_NONBLOCK/Unix assumptions, pypdf 6.18.0 versus pinned 6.19.0, CP950 child output and pre-commit dirty-tree checks; one fixture timeout passed isolated. Static gates and the Web production build passed.
